name: Airship
description: Airship is a mobile-first customer-experience platform for push notifications, in-app experiences, message center, SMS, email, journeys, experimentation, and audience data. Product and marketing teams use it to coordinate messaging and engagement across apps and digital channels.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated role-limited Airship bearer token and select its exact North American or European cloud site; agents can list a redacted first page of segment references through one fixed read-only endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRSHIP_BEARER_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Airship bearer token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated revocable dashboard token with only the role needed to view segments. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as a Bearer header to the selected Airship cloud site.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRSHIP_CLOUD_SITE
credentialRequirements.label: Airship cloud site
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter exactly na or eu. Relay maps the value to https://go.urbanairship.com or https://go.airship.eu.

capabilities.label: Read segment references
capabilities.description: Read page 1 of at most 25 segment UUID and lifecycle timestamp references while excluding display names, criteria, audience data, and pagination URLs.

approvalRequired.label: List Airship segment references
approvalRequired.description: Return at most 25 segment UUIDs and creation/modification timestamps with names, criteria, audiences, and next-page URLs removed.

blocked.label: Access segment names, criteria, or audiences
blocked.description: Display names, selectors, tags, attributes, locations, events, channel/named-user membership, audience counts, and pagination URLs remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access channels, users, messages, or analytics
blocked.description: Channels, addresses, named users, subscriptions, lists, message content, schedules, templates, reports, outcomes, experiments, journeys, and event streams remain blocked.

blocked.label: Send, write, delete, or administer Airship
blocked.description: Push/email/SMS/in-app sends, segment/list/channel/user changes, schedules, automations, imports, tokens, OAuth clients, webhooks, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Basic/Master secrets, OAuth clients, arbitrary cloud sites, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, starts, limits, pagination, raw responses, browser sessions, SDK surfaces, streams, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded segment-reference read requires approval; names, criteria, audiences, channels, messages, analytics, writes, administration, arbitrary APIs, pagination, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; token role, fixed cloud site/endpoint, redaction, result/response caps, audits, and provider authorization remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed regional Airship segment-reference wrapper with role-token authority and audience redaction.
Hermes receives the same fixed regional Airship segment-reference wrapper with role-token authority and audience redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Airship API access requires an eligible customer project and a customer-generated revocable bearer token whose role permits segment reads on the correct cloud site.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin generates a dedicated least-privilege dashboard bearer token, supplies na or eu for the project cloud site, and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Airship documents revocable dashboard bearer tokens with role-based permissions, separate NA/EU HTTP origins, mandatory versioned Accept headers, and GET /api/segments bearer-token support.
The Segment listing response includes UUID, display name, creation/modification epoch milliseconds, and next-page URL; Relay returns only UUID and timestamps from limit 25.
Airship's official library documentation supports customer bearer-token authentication as an alternative to App/Master secrets.
Airship documents a broad customer-experience product and API surface; Relay mounts only the fixed redacted segment-reference read.

securityNotes: The customer bearer token and cloud-site binding are encrypted as secret references; the token is sent only as a Bearer header to the allowlisted NA or EU HTTP API origin.
Relay allowlists only GET /api/segments?limit=25 with the mandatory version=3 Accept header, rejects redirects, uses a 30-second timeout, caps responses at 1 MB, and never follows next_page.
The result includes at most 25 valid segment UUIDs and non-negative epoch-millisecond creation/modification timestamps; display names, criteria, audience data, and pagination URLs are excluded.

Channels, users, lists, content, messages, reports, analytics, sends, schedules, writes, deletes, administration, Master secrets, OAuth clients, arbitrary APIs, SDKs, streams, pagination, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Provider 401/403/429 and server errors are surfaced safely; token creation/capture, role assignment, provider-console work, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
